title: SMOK 810 Drip Tip
description: Crown your tank with this sleek and stylish resin 810 drip tip from Smok. Featuring an edgy snakeskin pattern, this wide-bore drip tip is comfortable and durable and sits snugly on any tank that has a compatible 810 connection. You could fit this drip tip to any of Smok’s bestselling sub-ohm tanks like the Smok TFV8, TFV8 Big Baby, Prince or TFV12 & TFV12 tanks, or indeed any tank you like.
